name: Roast Potatoes with Bell Pepper, Chicken, Swiss Chard & Paprika Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg new potatoes
3 orange bell peppers
1 ½ bunches Swiss chard
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers; add to the baking sheets with the potatoes.
Peel, halve, and large dice onions; add to the baking sheets. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow onions
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, water, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp water
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl. (Set stems and leaves aside for later use.)
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground chicken
¾ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the chicken is done, add chard leaves to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Remove pot from the heat, add half of the cilantro, and stir to combine. Cover with a lid to keep warm. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
To serve, divide roasted veggies and chicken sauté between plates or bowls. Drizzle with sauce and top with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
